chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang descends into a frozen pool to find the hidden Supreme Irrigation Outlet.
chapter_meta_description: Haunted by a starving mothers hallucination, Li Huowang dives into a frozen abyss to find the time-locked Supreme Irrigation Outlet at the Hour of the Rat.
og_description: A new hallucination, a frozen pool, and a portal that only opens at midnight. Li Huowangs quiet, drowning nightmare continues.
twitter_description: Li Huowang is haunted by a starving womans ghost as he descends into a bottomless pool in search of a secret dimension.

lore_anchors.definition: A hidden, time-locked dimensional entrance that only appears at specific Chinese hours; currently concealed within a deep, frozen pool.
The traditional Chinese two-hour period from 11 PM to 1 AM, associated with the beginning of a new day and yang energy; a common time window for supernatural events.
A starving woman who died near Li Huowang and became one of his permanent hallucinations, eternally desperate for food and unable to save her child.
A phosphorescent mineral used by Li Huowang for illumination in the Dao-Twisted World; its sickly green light can push back darkness and unseen threats.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Qiu Chibao keep asking for food?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She is trapped in the moment of her death—starving and frantic—and cannot perceive that she is now a hallucination.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can’t Li Huowang just make the hallucination go away?
cultural_notes_faq.a: As a Heart-Element, his emotional state near someone’s death can permanently imprint them as a hallucination; he has no control over who stays or leaves.
